title: ID0417623-DC/Si-D/DK[qntu3k] - SECC timestamp not correct
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The charger timestamp for the SECC messages are not in sync with the actual time.
Solution:
Technical information provided - message not in sync shouldn't cause any issue. The reported issue was not due to messages out of synce
We found this error because the customer had issues with the charger.
It was unresponsive so they could not stop a ongoing session to release the car. This happened this morning (08-04-25), the charger was rebooted at 10:10 GMT to get the car released.
It have been working since.
Can the time issue have any influence on the stability of the charger?
The charger have the EcoG hotfix installed since Febuary 14 and the EcoG KF11 have been replaced February 18.

Problem Description
: SECC timestamp is not correct and EV was stuck
Troubleshooting
: As we already aligned, the EV being locked must be from the EV side, from IEC 61851-23, AA.3.4
We are not responsible for the locking mechanism, usually when we go from A to B2, we lock the EV after the SLAC is established and only when we go to B1 it must be unlocked since we don't have SLAC. You can see from the Normal Startup mentioned in the norm:
In B1, we don't have SLAC so we are not passing through t0→t1 even. So the locking should not happen. In the case of B2, it's possible that the EV is locked but as I can see from the logs we don't start SLAC so it also shouldn't be locking.
For the EcoG question about the timestamps I will try to get this information.
For future reference, your case number is
0417623
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
